rv.q: Mr. Quinn has found a way to make his brand of brainy comedy work in a theatrical format, delivering a breezy but substantive meditation on the rise and fall of civilizations that manages to be both educational and entertaining.
Colin Quinn is not trying to bring back the ethnic joke, is he? Please, he's much too deep and smart for that, right?

cn.t: Quinn delivers brainy, fast-moving comedy that's both educational and entertaining, though his meditation on New York's changing identity and "eggshell walking" civility occasionally flirts with nostalgia for a more divisive past.

vs.sum: One of Broadway's smallest houses (597 seats) and one of its newest, built in 2015 as Second Stage's permanent home. The intimate scale means excellent sightlines from nearly every seat, though the modern design prioritizes function over grandeur.

acc.note: Elevator from lower lobby to Mezzanine. LOOP system for t-coils and cochlear implants.
